hypothesis: Holding a 3x-levered Nasdaq ETF only while the underlying index is above its own 200-day simple moving average produces a positive excess annual return over SPY on data not used to select the rule.
known_limitation_stated_upfront: E31 measured this rule over the FULL 2016-2026 window before this registration, so the holdout is not virgin to the analyst. This seal therefore tests sub-period robustness (does it survive 2022's bear market and the levered-decay regime), NOT true out-of-sample discovery. It is weaker evidence than a true holdout and must not be reported as one.
no_tuning_clause: Exactly one grading run. No parameter may be changed after this file is committed. If the holdout fails, the result is FAILED and the rule is not adopted.

strategy.rebalance: daily evaluation, position changes only on signal flips
strategy.rule: long TQQQ on day D if close(QQQ, D-1) > SMA200(QQQ, D-1); else hold cash at 0% return

success_criteria_frozen_before_grading.primary: holdout annualised return STRICTLY GREATER THAN SPY's annualised return over the identical holdout window
success_criteria_frozen_before_grading.secondary: holdout Sharpe ratio STRICTLY GREATER THAN SPY's Sharpe over the identical holdout window
